selectionRules: one physical expansion or fall with no suction return
clean black carrier at the end
no generated player, tool, tile, scenery, text, or watermark
trim only; no interpolation, reverse frames, or ping-pong

selections.intendedUse: ordinary stone mining contact, anchored at the exact fist or foot contact point
selections.reason: compact burst, clean carrier, outward chips and gravity-led fall
dark smoke wheel and persistent crosshair-like center are less native to the current material language

selections.intendedUse: ore and metal mining contact, scaled down and tinted by material family
selections.reason: single warm spark fan with outward momentum and a clean decay
radial streaks fill too much of the screen for frequent contact feedback

selections.intendedUse: rare crystal contact or shatter accent, composited additively at reduced scale
selections.reason: high-impact faceted burst with forward radial travel, stable identity, and full decay
action is already bright on its first source frame, creating a visible trigger pop

selections.intendedUse: magma and ember-ore hit response at the contact point
selections.reason: compact molten chips and droplets continue outward and downward without reversing
excellent spectacle but too large for the most frequent hit event

selections.intendedUse: normal dirt tile destruction, centered over the tile as it is removed
selections.reason: localized eruption, coherent debris fall, natural residue, and clean final carrier
vertical plume is strong but reads as a heavy ground rupture rather than routine mining

selections.intendedUse: stone destruction swap; hide the exact tile as the keyed fracture covers its bounds
selections.reason: readable gray fracture, outward angular shards, and clean forward fall
beautiful but crystalline symmetry conflicts with ordinary stone
